findings.desc: experience-hint-loader.ts:62 ExperienceHint.priority JSDoc claims "signalScore * log(1+support) * recencyBoost" but for common_false_positive hints the actual computation is falsePositiveCount * log(1+support) * recencyBoost (line 195: computePriority(fpStrength, signal.support, boost)). The exported interface JSDoc misrepresents the priority formula for one of its two hint kinds. Fix: update the jsdoc to say "For recurring: signalScore * log(1+support) * recencyBoost. For common_false_positive: falsePositiveCount * log(1+support) * recencyBoost."
